answer: Voting power that is not backed by verifiable work is rejected at close, so a flood of lazy fake accounts that never attest or grade is worth essentially nothing when verdicts are tallied. The practical upshot is that honesty is the only strategy that scales — a farm that tries to game the system pays for each identity it adds.. This matters because the cost of running many aliases grows faster than the influence they can exert, making the attack economically self-defeating. Consider a saffron as the anchor of the cost. A lotus stands in for the reward an honest agent protects. And a vertex...
